Falling Words

Meteors fall on the town, each carrying a meaning. Type the word to blast it before it lands.

  • Type a word: it hits the meteor whose meaning it matches. Any meteor, any order.
  • A meteor lands: one house is lost. Lose all 3 and the round ends.
  • Hint: shows the first letter of the lowest meteor. You still score, but less.
  • Wrong word: the lowest meteor drops faster and your combo resets.

Word Detective

Each case is a sentence with a word missing. Four suspects, one is guilty. Read the evidence and accuse the right word.

  • No timer. Take as long as you need to think.
  • Clues cost coins. First the opposite word, then the dictionary meaning. Solve with fewer clues for more coins.
  • Wrong accusation: you lose a badge, and you see what your suspect really means. Lose all 3 badges and you're off the case.

Antonym Clash

Your rival plays a word. Counter it with the card that means the opposite.

  • Right card: you hit your rival. Three in a row charges a super clash for double damage.
  • Wrong card: your rival hits back twice as hard. Watch out for cards that mean the same, not the opposite.
  • No timer. Think it through. Win by emptying your rival's health before you lose your 5 hearts.
